_eligibility_text:
**Eligibility** 

1. After the registration by the construction worker, the membership period of the board should have been completed for at least 365 days.
1. Provision has been made for application within 1 year of marriage and 15 days before in case of mass marriage.
1. Aadhaar authentication of the daughter of the beneficiary labor has been made mandatory.
1. The benefit is limited subject to the limit of 2 children.
1. The benefit of the scheme will be admissible after the daughter and the proposed bridegroom complete the prescribed age of 18 years and 21 years respectively.
